name: Cohiba Siglo I
description: The most compact of the Siglo line, offering a quick yet refined smoke with creamy sweetness and gentle cedar notes. Perfect for a short afternoon break.
pairings: Cuban White Rum (Havana Club 3, Ron Arecha)
VSOP Cognac (Hennessy VSOP, Pierre Ferrand Ambre)

name: Cohiba Siglo II
description: A balanced petit corona offering the classic Siglo profile with creamy cedar and subtle leather. An excellent introduction to the Siglo series.
pairings: Cuban White Rum (Havana Club 3, Ron Arecha)
VSOP Cognac (Hennessy VSOP, Pierre Ferrand Ambre)

name: Cohiba Siglo III
description: A long corona with evolving complexity from cream to coffee to nutty finish. One of the most praised Siglo vitolas for its balance.
pairings: VSOP Cognac (Hennessy VSOP, Pierre Ferrand Ambre)
Aged Demerara Rum (El Dorado 12, Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva)

name: Cohiba Siglo IV
description: A rich corona gorda with full Siglo complexity — cedar, leather, cocoa, and a spicy finish. Often considered the best value in the Siglo line.
pairings: VSOP Cognac (Hennessy VSOP, Pierre Ferrand Ambre)
Aged Demerara Rum (El Dorado 12, Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva)
